title: Goals
intro: Set a goal, see what looks realistic from your recent runs, and let the AI suggest trainings up to the day.
unavailable: Goals are not available right now.
notMedicalAdvice: Suggestions are general training ideas, not medical advice. Listen to your body.

list.empty: You have no goals yet. A goal gives the plan something to aim at: a race, a time or a distance.

typeHint.Race: A specific event on a fixed date.
typeHint.Performance: A distance with a target time.
typeHint.Distance: Reach a distance, no time needed.

form.raceRunHint: Choose a planned race from your diary; its date becomes the target date.

validation.titleTooLong: The title can have at most 120 characters.
validation.dateTooSoon: The target date must be at least 7 days from today.
validation.dateTooFar: The target date must be within the next two years.
validation.distance: Enter a distance between 1 and 250 km.
validation.elevation: Enter an elevation between 0 and 10,000 m.
validation.targetTime: Enter the time as h:mm:ss, e.g. 0:55:00.
validation.targetTimeRequired: A performance goal needs a target time.
validation.targetPace: That time implies a pace outside 2:30 to 15:00 /km.
validation.eventTooLong: The event name can have at most 150 characters.
validation.locationLatitude: Choose a place on the map again: the latitude is out of range.
validation.locationLongitude: Choose a place on the map again: the longitude is out of range.
validation.locationNameTooLong: The place name can have at most 200 characters.
validation.notesTooLong: Notes can have at most 1,000 characters.

problem.goalLimit: You have reached the maximum number of goals. Delete one to add another.
problem.concurrency: This goal was changed elsewhere since you opened it. Reload it to continue.

estimate.title: Realistic target
estimate.based: Based on your {{distance}} on {{date}}, about {{time}} looks realistic ({{pace}}).
estimate.basisRun: Based on a recent hard effort of {{distance}} on {{date}}, about {{time}} looks realistic ({{pace}}).
estimate.lowConfidence: Low confidence: the effort it is based on is quite different from this goal.
estimate.none: There is no recent race or hard effort to base a time on yet.
estimate.failed: Could not check what is realistic right now.
estimate.basisTraining_one: Based on {{count}} recent training run, about {{time}} looks realistic ({{pace}}). A rough estimate.
estimate.basisTraining_other: Based on {{count}} recent training runs, about {{time}} looks realistic ({{pace}}). A rough estimate.

warnings.noRecentEffort: No race or hard effort in the last year, so there is no basis for a time prediction.
warnings.targetMuchFasterThanPredicted: This target is about {{value}} % faster than your recent form suggests. It is ambitious.
warnings.tooLittleTime_one: There is {{value}} week less than usually recommended for this distance.
warnings.tooLittleTime_other: There are {{value}} weeks less than usually recommended for this distance.
warnings.lowWeeklyVolume: Your recent weekly distance ({{value}}) is low for this goal.
warnings.beyondPlanHorizon: A plan covers 16 weeks at a time; regenerate later for the rest.

detail.raceDateChanged: The linked race run is now on {{date}}, not on the goal's date.

plan.title: Suggested trainings
plan.intro: The AI proposes trainings up to your goal, based on your recent runs. You decide what goes into your diary.
plan.unavailable: AI suggestions are not available right now.
plan.notActive: Only an active goal can have suggestions.
plan.runningHint: This can take up to two minutes.
plan.cancelCountsHint: Cancelling does not give the generation back: it still counts toward your plan limit.
plan.cancelled: Cancelled. If the plan was already finished, it will appear shortly.
plan.sourceDemo: Example plan for the demo data
plan.outdated: The goal changed since this plan was made. Regenerate to refresh it.

languageHint.en: This plan was generated in English.
languageHint.pl: This plan was generated in Polish.

plan.languageHintAction: Regenerate to get it in the current language.
plan.horizonCapped: Covers the next 16 weeks; regenerate later for the rest.
plan.dropped_one: {{count}} suggestion was skipped because you already have a run on that day.
plan.dropped_other: {{count}} suggestions were skipped because you already have runs on those days.
plan.replaced: Suggestions of other goals were replaced.
plan.empty: No suggestions yet. Generate some to see them here and in your diary.
plan.noOpen: No open suggestions. Regenerate to get a new set.
plan.ambitiousBody: Based on your recent runs, this plan trains toward ~{{time}}. {{target}} by {{date}} would need a big jump in fitness.
plan.ambitiousUseFailed: Could not change the target. Reload the page and try again.
plan.ambitiousUseDone: Target updated. Regenerate the plan to match it.

replace.title: Replace the other suggestions?
replace.description: Generating replaces the suggestions of "{{goal}}". Runs you already accepted stay in your diary.
replace.descriptionUnknown: Generating replaces the suggestions of your other goal. Runs you already accepted stay in your diary.

suggestion.failed: Could not update the suggestion. Please try again.

errors.featureUnavailable: AI suggestions are not available right now. Please try again later.
errors.busy: The AI is busy right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.busyWait: The AI is busy right now. Please try again in {{seconds}} s.
errors.quotaAccount: You have used all AI suggestions for now. You can generate again at {{time}}.
errors.quotaAccountNoTime: You have used all AI suggestions for now. Please try again later.
errors.quotaGuest: The AI suggestions of this demo session are used up.
errors.quotaGlobal: AI suggestions are used up for today. Please try again tomorrow.
errors.inProgress: A plan is already being generated for your account. Wait for it to finish.
errors.failedInvalidOutput: The AI could not produce a safe plan. Try again later.
errors.failedTimeout: The AI took too long to answer. Nothing was changed. Try again later.
errors.failedProvider: The AI service had a problem. Nothing was changed. Try again later.
errors.insufficientHistory: Log at least 3 runs in the last 12 weeks so the plan can start from your current training.
errors.goalNotEligible: This goal is not active or is less than 2 days away, so it cannot get suggestions.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.rateLimitedWait: Too many requests. Please try again in {{seconds}} s.
errors.concurrency: The goal changed while the plan was being made. Reload and generate again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
